title: Argo CD 5: ApplicationSets and Progressive Syncs
description: Generate Applications instead of writing them. Produce three from one object, discover them from repository folders and from your cluster registry, build a cross product with a matrix generator, then turn on progressive syncs and watch a rollout wait for each environment in turn.
